QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] Return of the Prime Minister
QuestInfo.0: That's one suspicious mushroom... He looks like the fugitive Prime Minister! Talk to him first and make sure he isn't really the Prime Minister.
QuestInfo.1: There's still something off about that mushroom. He's definitely the Prime Minister, isn't he? Tell everyone that he's back.
QuestInfo.2: The mushrooms were fooled by the one mole next to the Prime Minister's eye and flipped out when he revealed his identity... He proclaimed another war by bringing in the Vikings.

2.msg: (Hm... They look identical. He must be lying, I should interrogate him.)

0.msg: Obviously he is lying... Why would he risk coming back here? I have to let all the mushrooms know.
Oh, never mind. I thought you were another mushroom. Sorry.

default.0: Now that our kingdom is at peace again, all I wish for is a proper husband for my princess.

npc.0: I-I am not the Prime Minister. I swear.
